name: historical-evidence-repair
goal: All unverified history has intact evidence, exact-source reasons and real representative runtime profiles; budget growth retains independent review before completion.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Historical record 70043084 has identical owned source and runtime at aff45afc, but current scanner derives a different hooks Handle contract. Missing profiles include 32 styles and other declarative units; executable profiles still need real workloads. Full check e7 passes locally and CI; exact-commit job reached its three-hour limit.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: verification-check-shared checks cache reuse and changed logs using one scanner interpretation; it omitted derived-contract drift across scanner versions. Extend the same integrity suite with stored exact metadata versus upgraded derived interpretation, while retaining source, manifest and evidence tampering rejection.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red 74e7ea6d92b2444451f709f9d2aa545a24cb5adfe557dbb1fd49b0ab1a29d14b at b564121b rejects unchanged metadata under changed derived interpretation. The independent recorded-version tampering matrix passes.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Accept the exact committed stored manifest only for derived-contract interpretation drift when every other reconciled manifest field agrees. Recompute all version hashes from actual committed files and retain record, source, runtime, manifest and evidence integrity checks.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Current checker preserves only the exact stored derived contract when all other reconciled metadata agrees. Ten focused tests pass; altered source/version fields and changed ancestor evidence remain refused. Actual historical record 70043084 now passes integrity unchanged; source audit and types pass.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same-process sealed pair: red 88c74cb370eaf5e499066a7423c8e0e1192669859d5ee35a22e52ee0f48d0e78 at b564121b, green 42044fcf25911107b46c26eeeb5c16a2b5fdae9a289e551dbcf3f906ea98b274 at 8443ec11. Identical frozen tests and command pass; actual integrity latency and process peak RSS recorded.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The isolated immutable red snapshot restores the rejecting checker and fails the unchanged historical-contract assertion. The isolated green snapshot passes the same corpus, including every altered version-field refusal. Three additional ancestor-tampering cases and the registration guard pass in the normal focused suite.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
